style: Original flat SVG cartoon expressions and hairstyles. One identical peach rounded-square face base and skin color for all sixteen IDs. Accessory detail determines rarity, never gender or skin color.
origin: Code-authored original SVG artwork; no image generation, downloaded art or raster editing.
